sense: a room or building where people work at desks

pins.definition: A room, building, or area where people do administrative or clerical work.
A room or set of rooms in which people work at desks.
A room or building where people do business or clerical work.

situation: A worker sits at a wooden desk under fluorescent lights, surrounded by papers and a glowing computer monitor.
subject: the office workspace
brief: A neat row of identical wooden desks fills a brightly lit room, each holding a glowing monitor, a mug, and stacked files. A single rolling chair sits slightly askew at the central desk under harsh overhead light, marking the place where clerical work happens.
prompt: A neat row of identical wooden desks fills a brightly lit room, each holding a glowing monitor, a mug, and stacked files. A single rolling chair sits slightly askew at the central desk under harsh overhead light, marking the place where clerical work happens. a mid-century travel poster painted in gouache, rich opaque colour, confident simplified forms with real painted texture, strong diagonal composition.
